title: Restore the original dev-only multidimensional work counter contract
description:
Reconcile .5.3 original four-dimension dev-mode observation with the actual current three-field repaint record. WorkCounts currently contains tiles_redrawn:u32,pixels_damaged:u64,full_frame:bool; compositor RetainedRenderState.latest_work and both full/scoped writes are ungated; compositor and telemetry have no feature tables, and runtime dev-mode=[] does not propagate counting. Original layout/raster/upload observations are absent. The existing canonical one-node/fallback/overlap/idle gates exercise useful repaint behavior, so retain that real behavior and its assertions while delivering the authorized measurement boundary and dimensions. Do not remove WorkCounts merely because its drain has only test readers; the production writes are live and .5.3 is its retained counter owner.

Full corrected evidence head abbcfc63caf32caa0786c29d905d7cbe8bd44c99 and source582/history8f qualified; historical line numbers are navigation. Source-derived gaps are UNEXECUTED, not empirical red results. Current full ALL/related complete fields deduped; retain related hud-w2t3x/hud-ddm2g, telemetry3.11 and other live owners separately. design:
Authority is full .5.3 description/design (explicit four fields and dev-mode), parent5, current docs/vision.md proportional work and scope Working rules. Current exact owners: telemetry/src/work_counts.rs11 and lib.rs13/37; compositor/src/renderer/retained.rs45 private latest_work, begin_observation_frame118, scoped observation154, full observation177 and public take_work_counts189. frame.rs full/retained headless callers own real submission. Exactly9 current drain call expressions exist:7 inline runtime headless tests and2 compositor retained_image tests; no production/benchmark/T7 drain call exists. This does not erase the live producer. Restore documented four work dimensions through real existing preparation/raster/upload/damage owner operations, with explicit integer units and per-frame reset/drain semantics. Define exact four units without a new measurement framework: layout:u64 is the per-frame delta of existing TextRasterizer.shape_call_count (cache-miss shaping invocations, text.rs759/1628); raster:u64 is the sum of existing per-instance raster_count deltas (entered rasterize_and_upload invocations, not guaranteed successful rasters); upload:u64 counts actual widget RGBA queue.write_texture submissions at widget.rs2912; damage_px:u64 is clipped repaint-region pixels from PixelRect.area. Preserve the existing three repaint fields as supplemental observations with their9 current real test consumers; they never replace the four required dimensions. Keep raw existing shaping/raster counters live and unchanged; only the new WorkCounts observation/storage/writes/drain is dev/test opt-in. This narrowly defines existing measurable operations, not all glyphon/resource/static-image GPU uploads. A zero upload field therefore means zero observed widget RGBA submissions and never certifies an empty atlas/upload queue. Reuse existing per-instance widget raster counters/last-sync plumbing; never infer layout/raster/upload by copying tiles_redrawn, fabricate0 for an unobserved dimension, or claim a general no-upload result from the AB/BA glyph-inventory fixture. External glyphon work that cannot be observed must be explicitly bounded/documented, not silently counted as measured. Keep the current tiles_redrawn/pixels_damaged/full_frame repaint/fallback assertions and readers as explicit supplemental dev observations. This retains a current user rather than deleting instrumentation to make the type spelling match. Gate the observation storage/writes/hook and reexports behind dev/test configuration, propagate an opt-in existing dev-mode path through runtime/compositor/telemetry, and make existing selected tests opt in without changing the normal app default closure or silently dropping their targets. Counter gating must not disable retained rendering, its snapshots, widget/frame telemetry, cache work or GPU submission. Do not recreate the removed invalidation artifact or grow a certification API. Update all9 exact readers and existing canonical_one_node_update_repaints_only_the_changed_tile, transparent-overlap/fallback/recovery, static/no-render and new_observation_clears_prior_frame_work_counts assertions to observe the real dimensions/retained pixel behavior. Existing names stay. Correct telemetry lib stale Soak/DR-V8 module claim as part of this current counter documentation; .5.4 removed that owner. This is not a new soak.
